treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Hungary and the Government of the Republic of Iraq for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2016)
eif_quote: Kihirdetve: 2017. III. 16. Hatályba lép 2021. V. 6-án a 31/2021. (IV. 16.) KKM közlemény alapján.
source_title: secondary: Wolters Kluwer net.jogtar.hu reproduction of Hungarian Act IX of 2017 (Hungarian and English texts of the HU-IQ Convention); official njt.hu not reachable

rates.quote: However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

However, interest arising in a Contracting State may also be taxed in that State according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Interest taxable only in the residence State (Art. 11(3)) when paid in connection with credit sales of merchandise/equipment, on any bank loan or credit, to the other State's Government/subdivisions/central bank/government-owned or controlled financial institutions, or on loans guaranteed by them - not modelled. Royalty definition excludes equipment rentals. Art. 31(2)(a): WHT provisions apply to income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (EIF 2021-05-06 per KKM notice 31/2021 -> 2022-01-01), confirming the treaty map date read as 6 May 2021. Treaty Art. 28 'Entitlement to benefits' is a principal purposes test (with competent-authority consultation). Iraq is not an MLI signatory - MLI not applicable. Authentic in Hungarian, Arabic and English (English prevails); English quoted.
